mapper.sql: select crax_llave as key ,crax_comprobante as voucher ,crax_registro as recordLine ,crax_cuenta as account ,crax_auxiliartipo as auxiliarType ,crax_auxiliardocumento as auxiliarDocumentId ,(select cc.ccue_codigo from account.cuenta_cue cc where ccue_llave = crax_cuenta) as auxiliarCode ,(select cc.ccue_nombre from account.cuenta_cue cc where ccue_llave = crax_cuenta) as auxiliarName ,drax_creacionfecha as createdAt ,crax_creacionusuario as createdUser ,crax_creacionusuarionombre as createdUserName ,drax_modificacionfecha as updatedAt ,crax_estado as state from account.registroauxiliar_rax a
mapper.select: update account.registroauxiliar_rax set drax_modificacionfecha = now(), crax_comprobante = #{voucher}, crax_registro = #{recordLine}, crax_cuenta = #{account}, crax_auxiliartipo = #{auxiliarType}, crax_auxiliardocumento = #{auxiliarDocumentId}, crax_estado =#{state}
